title: A gift of gratitude
description: The repulsor train lay dead in the Dune Sea, and Boba Fett sat triumphantly by, as the remaining members of the Pyke syndicate are rounded up. To the surprise of nearly all present, Fett opted not to execute the prisoners, but instead he brokered a preliminary deal, and set up the lands as being the territory of the Tusken Raider tribes. Later, around a fire, the Tuskens offered Fett a token of their gratitude for what he had done for them, a small lizard that burrowed deep into Fett's nose.
